definition: A professional critique explicitly separates feedback into two confidence tiers and states the order to act on them: fixes the reviewer is CERTAIN about (a clear technical error against a stated principle) versus notes that are genuinely 'stuff to try' (an open judgment call with no single right answer, e.g. how many contact frames look best) — with explicit instruction to do all the certain fixes first, then return to experiment with the uncertain ones.
purpose: Prevent a recipient from treating every note as equally authoritative, and prevent wasted effort second-guessing a confident technical fix while an open judgment call is still unresolved — certainty about the FEEDBACK ITSELF, communicated explicitly, not left for the recipient to infer.
visible_effect: not applicable — a property of how feedback is communicated and ordered, not of the animation itself.
use_cases: any critique or automated review that mixes clear-cut technical defects with open-ended stylistic or numeric judgment calls — state which is which, and recommend doing the certain fixes first
non_use_cases: a review where every finding really is equally certain, where this distinction would add nothing
interactions: not applicable — this is the single clearest correspondence found in the whole batch between an external professional practice and an already-built Cadence mechanism, rather than a connection to another finding in this corpus.
cadence_representation: Already implemented, verified by reading the actual code rather than assumed: `renderer/js/ai/certainty.js` defines exactly five levels — `CERTAIN`, `HIGHLY_LIKELY`, `POSSIBLE`, `SUBJECTIVE`, `USER_INTENT_REQUIRED` — ranked in that order, and `ai/review.js`'s `sortFindings`/`certaintyRank` already sort every defect by this ranking, with `CERTAIN` findings first. `ai/review.js` also keeps `artistic_suggestions` in a SEPARATE array from `orderedDefects` (CLAUDE.md's own stated rule: 'defects and artistic suggestions never merge'), and reports a `confidence_summary` counting findings at each certainty level. This is exactly the two-tier, certain-first structure the video's reviewer describes doing by hand — Cadence's review tool already enforces it as data, not merely as a stated intention.
control_surface: `review_shot` (Part 49), which returns `orderedDefects` (sorted by `certaintyRank`) and `artistic_suggestions` (kept separate) plus a `confidence_summary`.
detection_and_measurement_methods: Directly measured today: every finding `review_shot` produces already carries a `certainty` field from the `CERTAINTY` enum, and the sort order IS the measurement.
generation_or_modification_methods: not applicable — `review_shot` is read-only (Part 11); nothing here generates or modifies animation.
failure_modes: presenting an uncertain, exploratory note with the same confidence as a certain technical defect, which the video's own reviewer explicitly avoids by naming which of his own notes are 'stuff to try'
a review tool merging defects and artistic suggestions into one undifferentiated list, which CLAUDE.md's own rule (and this video's practice) both reject
roblox_considerations: None specific — a feedback-communication practice independent of the target engine.
examples: the presenter's own words, verbatim: 'some of the feedback that I'm going to give you is some stuff to try[.] so what I want you to do is do all the other stuff that I'm certain on first and then come back and... mess around with the other things[.] so this is one of those notes where I'm not sure...' (transcript 16:12-16:31), given specifically about an open numeric judgment call (how many contact frames to show on the platform)
evidence_status: video: https://youtu.be/r_wQmGKUdZ4 @ 16:12-17:13 — Wayne Dixon (CG Cookie) explicitly separates certain fixes from exploratory suggestions and states the certain-first order directly, `efficient` detail with 50 keyframes; cross-checked in this session directly against `renderer/js/ai/certainty.js` and `ai/review.js`'s `sortFindings`/`certaintyRank`/`artistic_suggestions` handling; experimental until validated
